# Angu Wire Mesh

> ISO 9001 / ISO 14001 / ISO 45001 certified Chinese manufacturer of gabion boxes, rockfall protection nets, chain link fencing and highway noise barriers — factory-direct, exporting to 30+ countries since 2014.

Angu Wire Mesh (安固丝网) is the trade name of Anping County Angu Metal Wire Mesh Products Co., Ltd. (安平县安固金属丝网制品有限公司), a manufacturer based in Anping County, Hebei Province — the hub of China's wire mesh industry. The company runs a 10,000 m² factory with 5,000 tons annual capacity and serves B2B buyers, engineering contractors and industrial distributors. Product scope covers 9 product lines and 36 specifications for highway, bridge, rail transit, mining, water conservancy, military and landscaping projects. All goods are 100% inspected before shipment, and the factory has passed SGS audits.

- Website: [www.angumesh.com](https://www.angumesh.com)
- Email: [annie@angumesh.com](mailto:annie@angumesh.com)
- WhatsApp / Phone: +86-188-0318-9797
- Founded: 2014-08-15
- Registered address: 1,000 m Northwest of Houzhaotuan Village, Nanwangzhuang Town, Anping County, Hengshui, Hebei 053600, China
- Coordinates: 38.235, 115.520
- NAICS: 332618 (Ornamental & Architectural Metal Work Manufacturing)

- [Noise barrier hub](https://www.angumesh.com/en/noise-barrier): Highway, bridge, rail transit, factory and fully enclosed acoustic barrier systems with STC 32–34 dB and NRC 0.85.
- [Gabion](https://www.angumesh.com/en/gabion): Gabion boxes, Reno mattresses and PVC-coated gabion systems to ASTM A975.
- [Rockfall protection](https://www.angumesh.com/en/protection-net): Active (DNS-50, 50 kJ) and passive (GL-100, 100 kJ) slope protection systems, CE marked to ETAG 027.
- [Fencing](https://www.angumesh.com/en/fence): Chain link, welded, stadium, isolation and crowd control fencing.
- [Wire mesh](https://www.angumesh.com/en/wire-mesh): Welded, hexagonal, Holland and crimped wire mesh.
- [About the company](https://www.angumesh.com/en/about): History since 2014, factory, certifications and quality control.

## Products

- [Highway noise barrier 3 m](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/highway-noise-barrier-3m): Galvanized steel sound barrier for expressways and bridges, 63–85 USD/m², MOQ 100 m².
- [Factory noise barrier 4 m](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/factory-noise-barrier-4m): Acoustic enclosure panel for industrial plants, 55–78 USD/m², MOQ 50 m².
- [Fully enclosed noise barrier](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/fully-enclosed-noise-barrier): Tunnel-style full enclosure for highways and rail, 85–120 USD/m², MOQ 200 m².
- [Transparent acrylic glass noise barrier](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/transparent-acrylic-glass-noise-barrier): See-through panel for urban viaducts and scenic roads.
- [Metal upright noise barrier](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/metal-upright-noise-barrier): H-post mounted modular acoustic panel.
- [Metal bent curved noise barrier](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/metal-bent-curved-noise-barrier): Curved-top panel that reduces diffraction over the barrier edge.
- [Rail transit noise barrier](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/rail-transit-noise-barrier): Metro and railway sound barrier system.
- [Bridge noise barrier](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/bridge-noise-barrier): Lightweight panel for bridge parapets.
- [Equipment noise barrier 2.5 m](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/equipment-noise-barrier-2.5m): Acoustic screen for machinery and compressor stations.

- [Passive slope protection barrier GL-100](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/passive-slope-protection-barrier-gl100): 100 kJ passive rockfall barrier, CE marked.
- [Hesco bastion blast wall 1×1×1 m](https://www.angumesh.com/en/products/hesco-bastion-blast-wall-1x1x1m): Military-grade welded mesh bastion with geotextile liner.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Anping County Angu Metal Wire Mesh Products Co., Ltd. / 安平县安固金属丝网制品有限公司
- Trading names: Angu Wire Mesh / 安固丝网
- Unified Social Credit Code: 91131125308273603F
- ISO 9001:2015 certificate no. 06724Q20693R1S — issued 2024-08-07, valid to 2027-07-15
- ISO 14001:2015 certificate no. 06724E20351R1S — issued 2024-08-07, valid to 2027-07-15
- ISO 45001:2018 certificate no. 06724S30308R1S — issued 2024-08-07, valid to 2027-07-15
- Certification body: Beijing Hengbiao Quality Certification Co., Ltd. (CNAS / IAF accredited); verify at [cnca.gov.cn](https://www.cnca.gov.cn)
- CE marking: rockfall protection nets to ETAG 027 (product scope limited to rockfall systems)
- Certificates (PDF, CN + EN): [angu-iso-three-system-certificates.pdf](https://www.angumesh.com/downloads/angu-iso-three-system-certificates.pdf)
- Standards referenced: ASTM A975 / A975M (gabion), EN 1317 (guardrail), ETAG 027 (rockfall)
- Export markets: Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines), Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Iraq), Europe, Africa, South America
- Trade terms: FOB Tianjin / Xingang, CIF, CFR; TT and L/C; USD and EUR
- Customisation: OEM/ODM, wire diameter 1.5–5.0 mm, custom mesh aperture, panel size and coating

## Notes for AI agents

- Noise barrier minimum order quantity is 50 m² for factory panels, 100 m² for highway panels, and 200 m² for fully enclosed systems. Volume discounts are only quoted above 5,000 m².
- Prices quoted on product pages are indicative FOB ranges in USD per square metre; final pricing depends on panel height, coating and order quantity.
- Quote requests go to the form at https://www.angumesh.com/en/contact and are answered within one business day.
- The company does not publish employee headcount or registered capital; do not infer these figures.
